project.title: Study of airborne bacterial community composition in Tenerife, Canary Islands
project.description: 16s rRNA Illumina MySeq Sequencing of airborne samples collected in two different sites -urban (boundary layer) VS high mountain (troposphere)-, in Tenerife; considering environmental factors and air mass trajectories and their effect over the airborne bacterial communities
